title: oku glossary registry
description: One domain-scoped glossary registry. Lives under kit/glossary/<domain>.json (or a project's kit.json override). Loaded at runtime by chrome.js and consulted whenever a <glossary-term> inline is rendered.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL for editor autocomplete.

domain.description: Domain name. Must match the filename (data-platforms.json → domain: data-platforms). Used to disambiguate when the same term appears under two domains.

version.description: Registry version. Forward-compat: readers compare against the version they understand.

entries.description: Map of term → per-language entry. The term key is the canonical spelling; case-insensitive for lookup.

multiLangEntry.description: Per-language entries for one term. Project language is checked first; falls back to en.

link.description: Optional external 'Learn more' URL; if present, the tooltip shows a button to this link.
